tokens.name: table
tokens.note: Design tokens from docs/ui_mockups/ui_system.png ("01 Foundations"), as its swatches render: the swatches' labels (#625C56, #242321, #F2ECE1, #E9AD4A, #38DCFF) differ a little from the colors they show, and the screens are painted in the shown ones.

tokens.name: type
tokens.note: Type on the dark surfaces renders near-neutral white, cooler than the Text swatch.

tokens.name: stat-up-ink
tokens.note: A number raised or lowered against the printed one, as Arena inks it: deep inks on a card's pale plaque, bright ones on the dark surfaces.

tokens.name: stolen
tokens.note: A permanent its owner doesn't control (Card.tsx), apart from every glow.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.note: Buttons: one size for every action on the game screen, each in the action dock at the bottom right (components.css .button, screens.css .dock).

tokens.name: metal
tokens.note: Thin metallic borders: a pale gold line that catches the light.

tokens.name: metal-line
tokens.value: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgb(233 173 74 / 85%) 30%, rgb(255 226 170 / 95%) 50%, rgb(233 173 74 / 85%) 70%, transparent)

tokens.name: silver-line
tokens.value: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgb(220 214 204 / 70%) 30%, rgb(250 248 244 / 85%) 50%, rgb(220 214 204 / 70%) 70%, transparent)

tokens.name: font-card
tokens.value: "Crimson Pro Variable", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif
tokens.note: Card names, type lines, rules text and P/T.

tokens.name: playable-rgb
tokens.note: What the player can play or activate now: a green outline (screens.css .card-playable).

tokens.name: glow-gold
tokens.note: Source and target glows, as ui_system.png section 04 draws them: a white-hot line straddling the card's edge, a halo falling off fast with a faint tail, and light bleeding into the black frame (the -in shadows, inset). Cards on the table glow broader (screens.css).

tokens.note: The matte tabletop: warm brown under a faint grain, lit evenly across the middle and falling off to dark edges and darker corners (battlefield.png: #837069 across the middle, #493f3b at the sides' middle, #1b1818 in the corners).

TITLE.note: A prompt's question: the dock's `.prompt-title`, 26 points at weight 600, line height 1.15.

BUTTON.note: A button's label: `--button-font`, 24 points at weight 700, line height 1.

MENU.note: A menu row's label: `.table-menu`'s 14 points at line height 1.4 in `ui/src/table/menu.css`.

MENU_TITLE.note: A menu's title: `.table-menu-title strong`, bold 20 points at line height 1.2.

MENU_HINT.note: The key hint at a menu row's end: `.table-menu-hint`, 12 points.

TIP.note: A tooltip's words: `.tip` in `ui/src/design/components/tips.css`, 12.5 points at weight 600, line height 1.25.

FIELD.note: A text field's words: `.bug-text` in `ui/src/screens/styles/bug-report.css`, 15 points at line height 1.45.

BUTTON_HEIGHT.note: Every action button on the game screen.

BUTTON_WIDTH.note: The width of every button in the action dock.

BUTTON_PADDING.note: A button's padding on either side of its label: the `.button` rule's 0.9em at `--button-font`.

PANEL_RADIUS.note: The radius of a panel's corners.

BORDER.note: The width of a panel's or a button's border: the `.button` rule's 1.5px.

BUTTON_MIN_WIDTH.note: The narrowest a button is: the `.button` rule's `min-width: 8em` at `--button-font`.

ICON_BUTTON.note: The side of an icon button's round face: `.icon-button`'s width and height.

ICON.note: The side of the icon an icon button shows: `.icon-button > svg`.

SLIDER_TRACK.note: The height of a slider's track.

SLIDER_THUMB.note: The side of a slider's round thumb.

MENU_PADDING.note: The padding inside a menu's border: `.table-menu`'s `padding`.

MENU_RADIUS.note: The radius of a menu's corners.

MENU_ROW_HEIGHT.note: The least height of a menu row: `.table-menu-row`'s `min-height`.

MENU_ROW_RADIUS.note: The radius of the highlight behind a menu row.

MENU_CHECK.note: The column at a menu row's start that holds its check mark.

TIP_RADIUS.note: The radius of a tooltip's corners: `.tip`'s `border-radius`.

MENU_BORDER.note: The width of a menu's, a highlighted menu row's and a tooltip's border.

MENU_TITLE_PADDING_TOP.note: The padding above a menu's title: `.table-menu-title`'s `padding` of 7, 10 and 9 points.

MENU_TITLE_PADDING_BOTTOM.note: The padding below a menu's title.

MENU_TITLE_PADDING_SIDE.note: The padding either side of a menu's title.

MENU_GROUP_GAP.note: The room above and below the line over each group of a menu's rows: `.table-menu-group`'s `padding-top` and the `margin-top` between groups.

MENU_ROW_PADDING_Y.note: The padding above and below a menu row's words: `.table-menu-row`'s `padding: 3px 8px 3px 6px`.

MENU_ROW_PADDING_START.note: The padding before a menu row's check mark.

MENU_ROW_PADDING_END.note: The padding after a menu row's key hint.

MENU_ROW_GAP.note: The room between a menu row's check mark, words and key hint: `.table-menu-row`'s `gap`.

TIP_PADDING_Y.note: The padding above and below a tooltip's words: `.tip`'s `padding: 4px 9px`.

TIP_PADDING_X.note: The padding either side of a tooltip's words.

ICON_BUTTON_RIM.note: The width of an icon button's rim: the 1px inset ring of `.icon-button`'s `box-shadow`.

FIELD_PADDING_Y.note: A text field's padding above and below its text: `.bug-text`'s `padding: 10px 12px`.

FIELD_PADDING_X.note: A text field's padding on either side of its text: `.bug-text`'s `padding: 10px 12px`.

FIELD_BORDER.note: The width of a text field's border: `.bug-text`'s `border: 1px solid var(--metal)`.

FIELD_RADIUS.note: The radius of a text field's corners: `.bug-text`'s `border-radius`.

PANEL.note: `--surface`, slightly translucent for a panel over the table.

PRIMARY.note: A primary button's face: the middle of `.button-primary`'s amber gradient in `ui/src/design/components/buttons.css`.

PRIMARY_RIM.note: A primary button's gold rim: the side of `.button-primary`'s `border-color`.

PRIMARY_INK.note: A primary button's label: the `color` of `.button-primary`.

SECONDARY.note: Any other button's near-black face: the middle of `.button-secondary`'s gradient.

SECONDARY_RIM.note: Any other button's pale rim: the side of `.button-secondary`'s `border-color`.

SECONDARY_INK.note: Any other button's label: the `color` of `.button-secondary`.

DISABLED.note: A disabled button's flat stone face: the `background` of `.button:disabled`.

DISABLED_RIM.note: A disabled button's rim: the `border-color` of `.button:disabled`.

ICON_BUTTON.note: An icon button's round face of dark glass: the `background` of `.icon-button` in `ui/src/design/components/icon-button.css`.

ICON_BUTTON_PRESSED.note: An icon button's face while it is pressed: `.icon-button:active`.

ICON_BUTTON_RIM.note: An icon button's faint gold rim: the inset ring of `.icon-button`'s `box-shadow`.

ICON_BUTTON_RIM_HOVERED.note: An icon button's rim under the pointer: `.icon-button:hover`.

SLIDER_TRACK.note: The unfilled part of a slider's track, behind the `--gold` fill the web's `accent-color` gives a range input (`.sound-level input` in `ui/src/screens/styles/settings.css`).

MENU_ACTIVE.note: The highlighted menu row: `.table-menu-row[data-active]`'s `--gold` mixed 15% into `--surface`.

W.note: A white mana symbol's disc: `.mana-w` in `ui/src/design/components/mana-symbols.css`.

U.note: A blue mana symbol's disc: the middle stop of `.mana-u`'s gradient.

GENERIC.note: The disc of a number or any other symbol: `.mana-generic`.

INK.note: A mana symbol's glyph: the `color` of `.mana-symbol`.

U_INK.note: A blue mana symbol's glyph: the `color` of `.mana-u`.
